Nel bambino la fisi è il punto debole de: In children the physis is the weak point of the skeleton: after a fall on the outstretched hand, the distal radius often breaks through the growth plate. Salter-Harris classification: I physis only (widened or slipped); II physis + metaphyseal fragment (the most common, about 75%); III physis + epiphysis (articular); IV epiphysis + physis + metaphysis; V crush of the physis (often recognized only afterward). Here the epiphysis has slipped dorsally and carries with it a triangular metaphyseal fragment: type II. On the AP view the displacement may look minimal: the lateral is the view that shows the slip. Type I-II fractures of the distal radius have a good prognosis, but if displaced they must be reduced early; after reduction, position is checked. The ulnar styloid fracture must also always be looked for.
Polso del bambino: guarda la fisi in ent: Child's wrist: look at the physis in both views; a metaphyseal fragment with a widened or slipped physis is a Salter-Harris II.
